responsibility: This file owns the global streamer_hooks dispatch table used by GCC’s generic streaming code and provides its initializer. Its only functional responsibility is to define the mutable hook object and clear it to a known all-null state before a specific streamer implementation installs its callbacks for tree and location serialization.
same_name_distinction: This .c file is only the storage and reset implementation for the generic streaming hook mechanism: it defines the single global streamer_hooks object and zero-initializes it. In contrast, gcc/streamer-hooks.h defines the callback-table type, extern declaration, and stream_* call-site macros used by generic streamers.
